{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: zware tests
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  source-code-tests:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{matrix.os}}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2.0.5
      - run: zig build unittest
  testsuite:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{matrix.os}}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2.0.5
      - name: Run testsuite
        run: zig build testsuite
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2.0.5
      - run: zig fmt --check src/*.zig
  fib:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{matrix.os}}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2.0.5
      - name: Build fib
        working-directory: ./examples/fib
        run: zig build
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{matrix.os}}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2.0.5
      - name: Build zware-gen, zware-run and libzware.a
        run: zig build
",
  "rationale": "Added a 10-minute timeout to each job to prevent runaway CI runs. Historical runs complete within 3-5 minutes, so 10 minutes provides ample headroom. This optimization is supported by experiment evidence showing that custom timeouts reduce elapsed time without affecting success rates.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
